# MeshCentral desktop viewer

`internal/console/web/agent-desktop.js` is an unmodified copy of
`public/scripts/agent-desktop-0.0.2.js` from
https://github.com/Ylianst/MeshCentral at commit
`adce1ec488dc884ce947ea4e4808e6a520609b17`.

It is licensed under the accompanying Apache 2.0 LICENSE. The header
identifies author Ylian Saint-Hilaire. The Zireael-RMM adapter in support.js
is original CC0 code. No MeshCentral server or redirection wrapper is used.
